findings.rationale: Correct and load-bearing. Global Constraint 4 said the auto branch is untouched while KR1 promised a fail-closed exit on it; those cannot both hold. The constraint is rewritten: auto must never SELECT cursor, and a cursor- prefix reaching that branch is now a die_precondition with an implementing site added to the 3a map at line ~1679, placed before the *grok*/*gpt* tests.

Verified against the tree before accepting. status.js:42-49 is resolveConfiguredRunner, a model-family to native-runner map, so that site was spurious and is removed. resolve-review-loop.sh 263-266/344-349/538-581, probe-engine-capability.sh, and dispatch-status.js 172-174 cacheReadTokens were genuinely missing and are added. The transcript adapter is cut from this plan entirely: retro-review-loop.js accepts only --claude-root/--codex-root, so it had no transcript source.

Correct: the mapper had no call site and the fast input had no origin. Phase 1 now names its consumer (the post-parse effort-resolution site in dispatch-hetero.sh, added to the 3a map) and the origin of fast (a new --cursor-fast argv seam, default 0).

Correct that the transport was left undecided. Resolved with evidence already in hand rather than a new spike: the S2a probe ran --output-format text and returned clean assistant prose on stdout with empty stderr, now recorded as P13. Phase 3 binds both rails to --output-format text with exact argv, stdout/stderr separation, and fail-closed no_verdict conditions.

Correct that these were scope decisions wearing Board clothing. Q1 is decided in-plan (non-fast default, Global Constraint 6) and demoted to a later flip. Q3 is removed by cutting the node --check gate out of this plan into its own follow-up PATCH; R-5's mitigation now points there instead of at a section 5 row.

The same defect as the sol R2 finding, independently reached, and the sharper statement of it: the promised exit-2 had no implementing site anywhere in the 3a map. Site added at ~1679; KR1 and the Phase 2 acceptance now name that guard explicitly.

Correct: 6 families read as model families next to a two-family Phase 1 and a five-vendor section 0. It means the qualifier's 6 CASE families; the phase now names them and says so, and freezes the exact model id (cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast) with a stated reason and an explicit note that the evidence does not transfer to another suffix.

The same defect as the sol R4 finding, with the dependency-map consequence made explicit. Resolved the same way, and the plan takes this finding's own repair suggestion: the interim default is stated in-plan as non-fast, so Q1 becomes a later default flip rather than an open dependency of Phase 1.

Independently reached the same Phase 5 ambiguity from the qualification-binding angle, and is the reason the frozen id is now written into the phase rather than left as a mechanism. Resolved by the same repair.
Fixed: Phase 5 now states the frozen model id (cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast) instead of only the mechanism, with its selection reason and a non-transfer note.
